did.description: The account assigned, or asked to review.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

role.description: `assignee` to assign it, or `reviewer` to ask for a review of a pull.

removed.description: True to take the account off it, or stop asking, rather than assign or ask.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

assignees.description: Those it is assigned to now.

reviewers.description: For a pull, those asked to review it now; for an issue, none.

main.description: As `knotless pull assign`, `unassign`, `ask-review` and `unask-review` do: the repository's owner and collaborators rewrite their dev.knotless.assignment record about it, and a pull's author asks for reviews in the pull itself. A pull's author stops asking only those it asked, and a maintainer only those maintainers asked. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

description: Assigns a pull or an issue to an account, or asks it to review a pull, or no longer, as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
